title: Descriptor-guided Co–Co and Co–Ir oxygen electrocatalysts
summary: Physically informed feature selection derived an ARSC descriptor from calculated catalyst properties to guide oxygen-reaction candidate design. The study reports synthesis and alkaline testing of two carbon-supported samples: ORR half-wave potentials of 0.941 and 0.937 V and OER overpotentials of 330 and 340 mV at 10 mA cm−2. These are laboratory measurements; structural analyses support but do not prove every proposed active-site configuration.

evidence.tested: Publisher PDF reports synthesized Co–Co and Co–Ir samples with stated ORR and OER tests.
evidence.unknown: Prior composition overlap and independent replication remain open; specific active-site configuration is not directly resolved for every site.
evidence.ai_role: Calculated dual-atom catalyst descriptors selected candidates followed by synthesis and electrochemical testing.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
